TQ2-6.note: hl7.eu hl7v282segmTQ2.htm prints the Length of TQ2-6 Sequence Condition Code as "2.." (a minimum of 2, no maximum; std281 prints none). The ledger reads the largest number in the column, 2; the length is the maximum, and with none printed the spec keeps 0 (no maximum), as v2.8.1. Caristix answers HTTP 500 for 2.8.2 and HAPI has no v2.8.2 module, so nothing cross-checks it.
